name: Prawn & Egg Fried Rice
method: Cook the rice to the packet instructions and drain. Boil the peas and green vegetables for 1 minute, then drain.
Fry the chopped onion in half the oil over a medium heat for 10 minutes until golden, then add the garlic for a minute.
Tip in the blanched vegetables and fry for 5 minutes, then add the cooked prawns and fry for 2 minutes until hot through.
Stir in the rice, push everything to one side and scramble the beaten eggs in the gap.
Fold everything together with the soy sauce and vinegar and scatter over the sliced spring onion.
